sentences.zh: 光緒三十二年丙午，九月乙卯，定設外務部、吏部、民政部、度支部、禮部、學部、陸軍部、法部、農工商部、郵傳部、理藩部，各設尚書一、侍郎二；都察院設都御史一、副都御史二；均不分滿漢。戶、兵、刑部均改名。裁工部。

translations.literal: In Guangxu year 32, bingwu, in the ninth month on yimao, the ministries of Foreign Affairs, Personnel, Civil Administration, Finance, Rites, Education, Army, Law, Agriculture-Industry-Commerce, Posts and Communications, and Colonial Affairs were established, each with one minister and two vice ministers. The Censorate was given one censor-in-chief and two deputy censors-in-chief. None of these posts was divided into Manchu and Han seats. The Boards of Revenue, War, and Punishments were renamed, and the Board of Works was abolished.
